title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.16385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification

translated_title: FETERS：基于有效比率选择的少样本早期时间序列分类
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16385v1 公告类型：新 摘要：早期时间序列分类（ETSC）旨在尽早从部分观测的时间序列中做出准确预测。尽管已有多种停止机制和特征学习策略被开发用于ETSC，但大多数现有方法假设能够访问足够的标注训练数据，这在标注有限的现实应用中可能不切实际。在监督受限的情况下，学习额外的样本级停止模块和提取有效的分类特征都可能变得具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了FETERS，一种少样本ETSC框架，通过在支持集上进行类别级留一法（LOO）评估来选择数据集级停止比率，并使用基于惩罚的奖励函数来管理准确性与及时性之间的权衡，从而避免训练额外的停止模块。FETERS进一步将基于Rocket的特征与冻结的Chronos表示相结合用于分类。
tldr: 本文提出了一种少样本早期时间序列分类框架FETERS，通过类别级留一法选择停止比率和惩罚奖励函数管理权衡，结合Rocket特征与冻结Chronos表示，无需训练额外停止模块即可实现准确且及时的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FETERS, a few-shot early time-series classification framework that selects a stopping ratio via class-wise leave-one-out evaluation and manages accuracy-earliness trade-off with a penalty-based reward, combining Rocket features with frozen Chronos representations without training an extra stopping module.
